    How to use it

    1. Pick a preset: fire, smoke, sparks, magic, rain or explosion.
    2. Drag the sliders and watch it change live.
    3. Export JSON to keep it, a Godot scene for your game, or a sprite sheet / GIF.
    Do thisPhoneKeyboard
    PresetTap a preset1 to 6
    Move the emitterDrag or tap the previewTab to the preview, arrows (Shift = bigger steps)
    BurstBurst buttonB, or Space on the preview
    Pause / playPause buttonP
    Change a settingDrag a sliderTab to it, ← →
    Export / importTap the buttonsTab to them, Enter

    No accounts, no cookies. Saves stay on your device. Cookie-free visit counts via GoatCounter. Privacy
